exposure: Maternal high-risk pregnancy (due to chronic stress, previous difficult birth)
outcome: Multiple congenital anomalies (palatoschisis, suspected heart defect later diagnosed as ASD, hip dysplasia)
cohort: One female neonate born with multiple anomalies whose mother experienced a high-risk pregnancy.
finding: A female neonate, born via Caesarean section following a high-risk pregnancy and prolonged labor, presented with multiple congenital anomalies and birth asphyxia, and despite a complex 18-year health journey including hydrocephalus, speech delay, and endocrine issues, achieved significant developmental progress and functional independence.
mod_finding: The prolonged delivery, which necessitated a Caesarean section, was associated with fetal suffering, hypoxic damage to brain structures, and lyophilic asphyxia at birth.
